blocker_resolutions.review_issue: Decision-second rewards cannot credit delayed-onset and held moves; recorded trigger value was ignored.
blocker_resolutions.fix: Validate the complete observable-neighbourhood SUMO reward stream, then construct per-CAV discounted returns over every remaining control second of each complete episode before either optimizer runs. The residual receives return-to-go. Trigger PPO receives return-to-go as its value target and return minus its recorded per-CAV trigger value as its advantage.

registration.gamma: exp(-1/600), once per physical control second
registration.return_method: Full-rollout Monte Carlo return, not lambda-truncated GAE; no new hyperparameter or credit horizon
registration.formula: G_i(t) = reward_i(t)/UNIT + GAMMA * G_i(t+1); trigger_advantage_i(t) = G_i(t) - recorded_trigger_value_i(t)
registration.residual_baseline: Zero: the cooperation residual has no per-CAV value head; the frozen global MAPPO critic is not used as a per-CAV neighbourhood baseline.

blocker_resolutions.identity_and_boundaries: Join outcomes by episode_id,time_s,cav_id, not row or member position. Reset at each episode end, explicit done/terminated tick, or CAV departure. A reused ID after absence starts a new lifetime. Empty-member ticks remain temporal boundaries but are excluded from optimization.
blocker_resolutions.completeness: Every recorded tick requires outcomes for its present CAVs, including deterministic or externally executed ticks that are not PPO-eligible. Missing later outcomes, missing ticks, duplicate episode identity, truncated receipts, and a final tick inconsistent with actual_sim_s refuse before optimization. Complete finite-horizon receipts bootstrap to zero as in the inherited learner.
regressions: For BOTH B and R: real episode_components, V2V controller, EpisodePolicy, MoveExecutor, residual Adam and trigger PPO over t300..363. Legal ease_off moves have onset=2, hold=20, depth=0.3; both selected commitments are accepted, offsets stay zero before onset and -0.3 throughout the full hold, then expire.

Identical action/observation/RNG tapes with only opposite delayed SUMO outcomes yield opposite originating-decision return/advantage targets and different trigger actor, trigger value, and residual parameters. The frozen MAPPO base stays byte-identical and gradient-free.
Outcomes after the next registered decision at t360 still contribute to the originating t300 decision; no decision-interval truncation.
Actual accel_plant.episode 900-tick CPU fake-physics receipt: the t1199 outcome reaches the t300 target with discount GAMMA**899, preserving the full production horizon.
CAV order changes, departure/re-entry, terminal ticks, overlapping episode times, and nonzero recorded trigger values retain correct identity, boundaries, and baseline subtraction.
Non-optimizable executed-tick rewards reach the prior trigger; all-CAV departure ticks are not optimized.
Nine invalid temporal-tape cases refuse before the layer optimizer, including missing later executed-tick outcomes.

api.build_arm_runtime(cfg, arm): Returns production hooks: runtime, policy, policy_factory, bank_pairs, collect_update, safety, train_update, save_checkpoint, episode_components. Building dispatches no simulation.
api.collect_update(cfg, arm, u): Uses the real accel_runner/accel_plant V2V path and existing practice/bank readers.
hook_order: Build with cfg.update=u; collect A before same-update B/R safety references.
Collect complete episodes and call hooks.safety(episodes).
Call hooks.train_update(episodes, rewards=envelope), or omit rewards to import P2 reward_update lazily.
Publish diagnostics to parent monitoring, save_checkpoint, and publish B practice update_report before R requests B's realized practice count.

P2_dependency.function: reward_update(cfg, arm, u, episodes) -> reward envelope
P2_dependency.availability: External P2 integration dependency absent on this branch; tests use only a local fake and missing integration fails explicitly.

envelope.rows: per-CAV outcome rows for ALL recorded control ticks

P2_dependency.alignment: Exactly one row per episode/time/present CAV, including non-optimizable ticks. Neighbour IDs match sample.track2.reward_neighbourhoods[cav_id] exactly; member ordering may change between ticks.
P2_dependency.formula: reward = own_reward + registered weight * mean(observable neighbour rewards); empty neighbourhood contributes zero.

required_bank_arm_config: track2_reward={weight: finite registered number, provenance: nonempty registration reference}; common B/R configuration
api.reward_diagnostics: train_update returns reward.temporal with method, inherited gamma/reward_unit registration, trigger baseline and terminal rule, plus the validated real reward cav_rows count.
api.optimizer_contract: Residual marginal per-CAV Gaussian PPO retains the exact correlated joint KL guard; trigger PPO retains whole-update joint categorical KL. Rejections restore weights and Adam state. Base remains frozen.
api.augmentation: Existing verified-child v2 evidence gate and common cfg.augmentation_prelaunch provenance remain required.
api.disabled_clean_run_paths: dense_teacher=false, group_credit=false, extra coop_reward=false; nonempty labels/credit refuse.
api.bank_and_practice: Existing per_seed_v1 cooperative-only effective imitation, explicit 1.2 acceleration cap, frozen practice plans, own banks, R=B realized count, prefix stripping and matched pre-update A safety references.
api.accounting_and_approval: Own run_root ledger, total <=5000000 including parent phases and prior parity960; OWNER_APPROVAL.json approved=true required for collection; supplied approval SHA verified.
api.checkpoint: Normal arm checkpoint plus B/R cooperation/Adam sidecar, strict arm/update identity and exclusive writes.
api.horizon: Existing 1200 sim-s charge and t300..1199 control loop; full remaining rollout outcomes contribute to temporal credit.
